note: Single source of truth for the category taxonomy. Nodes carry id, display name, emoji, optional children, aliases (legacy category strings mapped to this node at runtime), and subcategories (the controlled list a node owns; an item's subcategory determines its category). Consumed by the site runtime (src/scripts/shared/data-loader.ts), the build (scripts/config/categories.js), and validation (scripts/validate-categories.js). Libraries are a separate axis and are NOT in this tree.

extensionAxes.note: Browser and VS Code extensions use their own flat classification (display names, not the slug-id category tree above), like the library axis. Display names must not contain '-'.

libraryAxis.note: Libraries/frameworks are a separate axis (not the slug-id tree). 'base' is the ordered display list; 'icons' maps each category to a Lucide icon name (includes extras used by the compatibility table).
